description: From the Megalou Alexandrou waterfront, Lake Orestiada lies in the foreground and mirrors the peninsula shore. Traditional mansions with stone bases and enclosed wooden balconies step up among plane trees. The sky is mostly clear, about 7.6°C, and the sun is still below the horizon. A few street lamps are on. The houses are not floodlit.
